fields.summary_ko.0: Meta recognized $9.89B in legal settlement provisions in Q3 (maximum total $18.59B), though operating performance excluding this is positive.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 achieved key milestones including launch of AI model 'Muse' and 'Muse Wonder'; Q4 revenue guidance of $73–76B.
fields.summary_ko.2: Raised 2026 capital expenditure guidance from $130–145B to $135–145B, with Reality Labs losses expected to narrow to $18–19B range.
